description: This file defines a skeleton implementation of an analytics service class for AI performance and metrics within a trading platform backend. It includes two methods for retrieving analytics snapshots and streaming seed metrics, serving as a placeholder or initial implementation.

classes.name: AnalyticsService

methods.name: AnalyticsSnapshot get_snapshot(self, user_id: str)
